name: toggle-group
summary: A compact row of options where the chosen one is highlighted: a white segment (`segment`) or a lime-outlined tile (`outline`).
useWhen: One short option out of a few must be picked inline, such as upscale factor or Visuals versus Sound (`segment`).
Visual options such as aspect ratios are shown as tiles (`outline`).

alternatives.name: tabs
alternatives.when: the choice switches which panel of content is shown

alternatives.name: radio-group
alternatives.when: each option needs a sentence of explanation

alternatives.name: select
alternatives.when: there are more than five options

rules.do: Keep a toggle group to two to five short options, such as 1x, 2x and 4x.
rules.dont: Squeeze long labels or many options into one row; they wrap and become hard to compare.

rules.do: Use single selection when options exclude each other, such as one aspect ratio at a time.
rules.dont: Allow several pressed segments for options that cannot combine.

a11y: Each item is a toggle button that announces whether it is pressed; arrow keys move between items.
Label the group (`aria-label`) with what is being chosen.
